intro: DR Congo contains most of the Congo Basin, the world's second-largest rainforest.

chapters.title: The Congo River
text: The Congo River is the deepest in the world and second only to the Amazon in the water it carries. It crosses the equator twice. The country has only a tiny Atlantic coastline.

chapters.title: Volcanoes and lakes
text: The east has Lake Tanganyika, Lake Kivu, the Rwenzori and active volcanoes like Nyiragongo. Virunga National Park shelters mountain gorillas, and bonobos live only in Congo's forests.

keyTerms.meaning: An ape closely related to chimpanzees.
